title: Cheat Sheet - C Syntax
markdown:
## A program

```c-norun
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    printf("Hello, C!\n");
    return 0;
}
```

## Types

| Type | Usual size | printf | scanf |
|---|---|---|---|
| `char` | 1 byte | `%c` | `" %c"` |
| `int` | 4 bytes | `%d` | `%d` |
| `unsigned` | 4 bytes | `%u` (`%x` hex) | `%u` |
| `long long` | 8 bytes | `%lld` | `%lld` |
| `double` | 8 bytes | `%f`, `%.2f`, `%g` | `%lf` |
| `size_t` | 8 bytes | `%zu` | `%zu` |
| `char *` (string) | 8 bytes | `%s` | `%63s` (with a width!) |
| any pointer | 8 bytes | `%p` with `(void *)` | |
| `uint32_t` etc. | exact | `"%" PRIu32` | `"%" SCNu32` |

`printf` widths: `%5d` (right-aligned in 5), `%-10s` (left-aligned in 10), `%05d` (zero-padded), `%.3f` (3 decimals), `%08x`.

## Operators, highest precedence first

| | |
|---|---|
| `()` `[]` `->` `.` `x++` `x--` | call, index, member |
| `!` `~` `-x` `*p` `&x` `++x` `sizeof` `(type)` | one operand |
| `*` `/` `%` | multiply, divide, remainder |
| `+` `-` | |
| `<<` `>>` | shifts |
| `<` `<=` `>` `>=` | |
| `==` `!=` | |
| `&` then `^` then `\|` | bitwise |
| `&&` then `\|\|` | logical, short-circuit |
| `?:` | conditional |
| `=` `+=` `-=` `*=` `/=` `%=` `&=` `\|=` `^=` `<<=` `>>=` | assignment |

When in doubt, add parentheses: `(flags & MASK) == 0`.

## Control flow

```c-norun
if (a > b) { ... } else if (a == b) { ... } else { ... }

switch (c) {
case 'a': ...; break;
case 'b':
case 'c': ...; break;
default: ...; break;
}

while (condition) { ... }
do { ... } while (condition);
for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { ... }
break;      // leave the loop
continue;   // next round
```

## Functions

```c-norun
int add(int a, int b);                 // prototype (declaration)
int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
void swap(int *a, int *b);             // change the caller's variables
static int helper(void);               // private to this file
int (*op)(int, int) = add;             // function pointer
```

## Arrays and strings

```c-norun
int a[5] = {1, 2, 3};                  // rest are 0
size_t n = sizeof a / sizeof a[0];     // only where a is declared
char name[32] = "Ada";                 // 4 bytes used: 'A' 'd' 'a' '\0'
const char *literal = "read-only";
fgets(line, sizeof line, stdin);       // read a line, keeps the '\n'
line[strcspn(line, "\n")] = '\0';      // remove it
snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s-%d", s, n);
strcmp(a, b) == 0                      // equal strings
```

## Pointers

```c-norun
int x = 5;
int *p = &x;        // p holds x's address
*p = 6;             // x is now 6
p[i]                // the same as *(p + i)
const int *r;       // cannot change *r
int *const q = &x;  // cannot change q
int **pp = &p;      // pointer to a pointer
```

## Heap memory

```c-norun
int *v = malloc(n * sizeof *v);
if (v == NULL) { /* out of memory */ }
int *bigger = realloc(v, 2 * n * sizeof *v);
if (bigger != NULL) v = bigger;
free(v);
v = NULL;
```

## Structures

```c-norun
struct point { double x, y; };
typedef struct node { int value; struct node *next; } Node;
struct point p = {.x = 1, .y = 2};
p.x = 3;
struct point *pp = &p;
pp->y = 4;          // (*pp).y
enum color { RED, GREEN, BLUE };
```

## Files

```c-norun
FILE *f = fopen("data.txt", "r");     // "w" "a" "rb" "wb"
if (f == NULL) { perror("data.txt"); return 1; }
fgets(line, sizeof line, f);
fprintf(f, "%d\n", n);
fread(buffer, sizeof buffer[0], count, f);
fwrite(buffer, sizeof buffer[0], count, f);
fclose(f);
```

## Preprocessor

```c-norun
#include <stdio.h>         // system header
#include "mine.h"          // your header
#define MAX 100
#define SQUARE(x) ((x) * (x))
#ifndef MINE_H
#define MINE_H
...
#endif
```

## Building by hand

```
gcc -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -g main.c other.c -o program -lm
gcc -fsanitize=address,undefined -g main.c -o program     # memory checks
gcc -O2 main.c -o program                                  # optimised
gcc -S -masm=intel main.c                                  # see the assembly
```
